heard: In the days of Joachim, the high priesthood heads of the fathers' houses in the city found From the exile we return to the rebuilt place to keep the order of this sacred grace Of Harim Adna is named in the list Of Meraioth Helke is the priest Of the line of marriage, oh, he leads the way In the days of joy, I came each day Yeshua, Father, joy, I came in the record clear Eliash, Shabdan, Shoyet, Adah, through the years Jonathan and Jadu, a following line Serving the temple in Jerusalem Shrine of Harim Agna is named in
